text.tspan: Per capita CO₂ emissions from domestic aviation vs. GDP per capita 2024
Domestic aviation represents flights which depart and arrive within the same country. GDP per capita is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Per capita CO₂ emissions from domestic aviation (kilograms)

tspan.tspan: OECD (2025); Population based on various sources (2024); World Bank (2025)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
